descriptionChirho: A cord or line used for measuring, surveying, or marking boundaries. Central to construction and judgment imagery: the measuring line of Samaria stretched over Jerusalem (2 Kgs 21:13), the line and plummet of destruction (Isa 34:11, 17), the measuring line in Ezekiel's temple vision (Ezek 47:3), the line of justice and righteousness (Isa 28:17, 44:13), and the surveying line over Jerusalem restored (Zech 1:16, Lam 2:8). In Ps 19:4 'their line' (qawwam) refers to the heavens' measuring reach across the earth. Consistently rendered Arabic khayt (خَيْط, cord/thread), Korean jul (줄, line/cord), Hindi dori (डोरी, string/cord), Spanish cordel/cuerda/linea, German Linie/Richtschnur. The semantic range spans literal building measurement to metaphorical divine judgment.
